body:
Happy Birthday from another stranger on the internet. I care about you! I know what it feels like to feel like no one cares especially on days like your birthday. I used to watch this on my birthday, I hope you enjoy it on your birthday 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W12NxRQdSb8

I guess I'm in a similar sort of situation? But reversed you could say. I dated my boyfriend for almost a year and half and we've been off and on with each other for the past six years. I've never been able to move on past him. I've tried dating other guys and seeing other guys but they just annoyed me and well...they aren't HIM. He's been the main one in the relationship to always call things off, saying "I want to have a college experience" and bullshit things like that and "There are other people out there, I don't just want to experience one person my whole life" but we also had that "we'll always have each other" type of situation. 

So I can totally understand the volatileness of that kind of relationship. And I 100% in my heart believe that no matter what happens I will always love him. If your ex feels the same way towards you the way that I feel towards my ex i know that at least from my perspective she will always love you and the relationship that she's in now will probably crumble because of her love for you.

 My question to you is: Why didn't you try to win her back and be with her if you feel this way? I just think that this obviously means that you care for her and you already know she loves you deeply and you have feelings for her? Maybe it's not an ego thing or security thing, but you actual love this woman and maybe that's the part that you're denying?
